title: wire the dead links on the messscribe landing
description:
Why now: the Attio Senior Design Engineer application cites ssscribe.app as evidence of a shipped landing page, and a Studio reviewer will click through it. Empty links undercut exactly the craft claim being made.

Scope:
1. Audit every link/CTA on the landing: grep for href="#", href="", empty onClick handlers, buttons with no action. List each with a proposed real target.
2. Mike approves targets BEFORE wiring. Some destinations are product decisions: the app itself is private/single-user at app.ssscribe.app, so get-started-type CTAs cannot link to a signup — options are GitHub, mailto, a demo, or dropping the CTA. Mike's call per link.
3. While in there, flag (do not fix unasked): placeholder title/meta/og tags, missing favicon.
4. Discover how this repo deploys (config files, git remote, ask Mike if ambiguous) and redeploy after the fix.

Out of scope: redesign, copy rewrites, new sections.
acceptance_criteria: No dead or empty links on the live page at ssscribe.app; every target approved by Mike; redeployed and verified live.

title: dot-grid: lift content above canvas + general polish
description:
dots from the fixed dot-grid canvas (src/components/landing/dot-grid-background.tsx) paint OVER opaque content — visible on the chat preview mockup (white card) in the 'try it in your language' section. root cause: the canvas is position:fixed, and positioned elements paint above non-positioned siblings regardless of DOM order, so any non-positioned opaque surface loses.

suggested fix: wrap PageShell children in a position:relative + z-index:1 container (primitives.tsx) so all content stacks above the canvas; dots stay visible through transparent section backgrounds, but white cards/mockups properly cover them. verify the sticky nav (z-10) and hero art stacking still hold.

while in there, general dot-grid polish ideas: tune BASE_ALPHA/spacing per feedback, consider a subtle accent tint in the cursor halo, and check dpr>2 displays.
close_reason: fixed: PageShell now wraps children in a position:relative/z-index:1 layer so the fixed dot-grid canvas paints behind every section. verified in the built page at 1280px — dots no longer land on the white chat-preview card. the 'general polish' ideas (BASE_ALPHA tuning, accent tint in the cursor halo, dpr>2) were not touched and are not tracked here.
